title: Ahornbahn Mayrhofen
highlights: Austria's largest aerial tramway accommodating up to 160 passengers
Pleasure mountain Ahorn featuring Lake Ahorn and sensory trails
Spectacular Eagle's Stage Ahorn with birds of prey flight demonstrations
Glorious Zillertal viewing platform and scenic panorama hikes
kurzbeschreibung: The Ahornbahn, Austria's largest reversible aerial tramway, opens up leisure mountain Ahorn with AhornSee and the birds of prey Adlerbühne Ahorn.
beschreibung:
Floating up to Leisure Mountain Ahorn

The Ahornbahn in Mayrhofen is Austria's largest reversible aerial tramway and a true engineering masterpiece. With its spacious cabins, it glides smoothly up to the sunny Ahorn plateau, considered a tranquil retreat and the pleasure mountain of the Zillertal, providing sweeping vistas across the Zillertaler Alpen.

Nature Experience and Adlerbühne

On the high plateau, the idyllically situated AhornSee and the refreshing AhornBach stream invite guests to linger and unwind. A very special highlight is Europe's highest bird of prey sanctuary, the Adlerbühne Ahorn, where eagles, buzzards, and eagle owls can be admired up close in fascinating flight demonstrations.
